title: Thornroot Cuttings
description: Alchemist Vell needs blossoms cut from the living lashers themselves — the fevered growth, not the tame meadow herb — to distil a stronger cure. It means fighting the bloodthorn where it grows thickest, but a careful hunter can take them one at a time. Bring back clean cuttings.

objectives.desc: Take clean blossoms from the lashers
